title: A collection of principles for guiding and evaluating large language models

bias_targets.methodology: The paper does not empirically measure bias in a model's outputs. Instead, it proposes the absence of "problematic social biases" as a theoretical core ethical principle for evaluating LLMs, and evaluates the perceived importance of this principle through a small-scale expert survey.

The paper does not conduct empirical measurements of cognitive bias. It includes the absence of "cognitive biases or fallacies" as a core reasoning principle for LLM evaluation and surveys domain experts to rate its importance.
